timing: Post-result documentation only; no estimator mode, input, likelihood basis, gate, or denominator was changed.

descriptive_findings.planned_missingness: Relative to complete data, estimator shifts from Python JMLE were larger for CMLE and both MML modes; free-SD MML estimated SD was also higher under the planned-connected design despite the same Persons.
descriptive_findings.response_model: Every joint, marginal, and conditional likelihood mode showed a larger PCM-over-RSM gain under heterogeneous than shared thresholds. Shared conditions favored RSM by within-basis AIC; heterogeneous conditions favored PCM.

interpretation: The bridge demonstrates computable and internally ready estimands on identical rows. Observed RMSE and shift differences at two replicates are sensitivity signals, not estimator rankings.
withheld: No bias, coverage, false-positive, power, model-selection error-rate, universal missingness, or automatic estimator recommendation claim.
